seoTitle: Fix 'App Isn't Compatible' Error on Shopify
metaDescription: Troubleshoot the Shopify error blocking TikTok and other app installs, from checking eligibility and country restrictions to fixing install issues.
intro: The 'This app isn't compatible with your store' message can stop you from installing TikTok, Facebook, or other integrations without much explanation. This guide covers why the error appears, how to check store eligibility and country restrictions, and how to troubleshoot third-party app installation issues generally.

steps.heading: Understand why this error happens
steps.body: Shopify shows this message when an app isn't supported for your store's configuration, which can stem from several different underlying causes.

steps.heading: Check store eligibility and country restrictions
steps.body: Some apps, including certain TikTok integrations, are limited to specific countries or store types, so verifying eligibility is a key first step.

steps.heading: Fix the TikTok app not compatible issue
steps.body: For TikTok specifically, confirm your store meets the app's requirements and try reinstalling once any blockers are addressed.

steps.heading: Troubleshoot other apps
steps.body: The same general troubleshooting approach — checking eligibility, restrictions, and store settings — applies when other third-party apps show the same compatibility error.

faq.question: Why does Shopify say an app isn't compatible with my store?
faq.answer: This typically relates to store eligibility, country restrictions, or configuration mismatches between your store and the app's requirements.

faq.question: Is this error specific to TikTok?
faq.answer: No, while TikTok is a common example, the same compatibility error can appear when installing Facebook or other third-party apps too.

faq.question: Can country restrictions cause this error?
faq.answer: Yes, some apps are only available in certain countries, and installing from an unsupported region can trigger this compatibility error.

faq.question: What should I check first when I see this error?
faq.answer: Start by checking your store's eligibility and any country restrictions tied to the specific app you're trying to install.
